61251-the-life-of-abraham-lincoln-for-yo.title: Told In Words Of One Syllable
61251-the-life-of-abraham-lincoln-for-yo.creator: Harriet Putnam
61251-the-life-of-abraham-lincoln-for-yo.description: A book by Harriet Putnam. Near five scores of years have gone by since a poor, plain babe was born in a log hut on the banks of a small stream known as the “Big South Fork” of No-lin’s Creek. This was in Ken-tuc-ky and in what is now La-rue Coun-ty.

arxiv-2107-07674.title: Influence of NaI background and mass on testing the DAMA modulation
arxiv-2107-07674.creator: Madeleine J. Zurowski, Elisabetta Barberio
arxiv-2107-07674.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Madeleine J. Zurowski, Elisabetta Barberio. We present here the model dependent and independent sensitivity studies for NaI detectors designed to test the DAMA result, and compare the predicted limits from SABRE with the present performance of both ANAIS and COSINE. We find that the strongest discovery and exclusion limits are set by a detector with the lowest background (assuming equal live times), and also note that our method correctly computes the present exclusion limits previously published by ANAIS and COSINE.

arxiv-2110-06242.title: Widely-tunable, doubly-resonant Raman scattering on diamond in an open microcavity
arxiv-2110-06242.creator: Sigurd Flågan, Patrick Maletinsky, Richard J. Warburton, Daniel Riedel
arxiv-2110-06242.description: Abstract Raman lasers based on bulk diamond are a valuable resource for generating coherent light in wavelength regimes where no common laser diodes are available. Nevertheless, the widespread use of such lasers is limited by their high threshold power requirements on the order of several Watts.

arxiv-2201-02089.title: A Survey of JSON-compatible Binary Serialization Specifications
arxiv-2201-02089.creator: Juan Cruz Viotti, Mital Kinderkhedia
arxiv-2201-02089.description: Abstract In this paper, we present the recent advances that highlight the characteristics of JSON-compatible binary serialization specifications. We motivate the discussion by covering the history and evolution of binary serialization specifications across the years starting from 1960s to 2000s and onwards. We analyze the use cases of the most popular serialization specifications across the industries.

arxiv-2203-01752.title: Vertical Federated Principal Component Analysis and Its Kernel Extension on Feature-wise Distributed Data
arxiv-2203-01752.creator: Yiu-ming Cheung, Juyong Jiang, Feng Yu, Jian Lou
arxiv-2203-01752.description: Abstract Despite enormous research interest and rapid application of federated learning (FL) to various areas, existing studies mostly focus on supervised federated learning under the horizontally partitioned local dataset setting. This paper will study the unsupervised FL under the vertically partitioned dataset setting.

arxiv-2204-12027.title: On Routing, Wavelength, Network Coding Assignment and Protection Configuration Problem in Optical-processing-enabled Networks
arxiv-2204-12027.creator: Dao Thanh Hai
arxiv-2204-12027.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dao Thanh Hai. In optical-processing-enabled network, transitional lightpaths crossing the same node could be optically encoded to each other to achieve greater spectral efficiency. In this context, we present a new research problem, entitled, routing, wavelength, network coding assignment and protection configuration (RWNCA-PC) arisen in exploiting photonic network coding (NC) for dedicated path protection in wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) networks with an extra degree of freedom in the selection of protection triggering mechanism, that is, network-side and client-side, tailoring to each connection.

arxiv-2206-12960.title: Buchsbaum-Eisenbud complexes of OI-modules Thanks: The second author was partially supported by Simons Foundation grant #636513.
arxiv-2206-12960.creator: Nathan Fieldsteel, Uwe Nagel
arxiv-2206-12960.description: Abstract . We extend the theory of Koszul and Buchsbaum-Eisenbud complexes to modules over commutative OI-algebras and show that they still have the familiar properties of the classical complexes. In particular, the OI-complexes are generically acyclic and often provide width-wise minimal free resolutions. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 13D02, 16W22 1.

pmc-10534530.title: Bioactive Properties, Bioavailability Profiles, and Clinical Evidence of the Potential Benefits of Black Pepper (Piper nigrum) and Red Pepper (Capsicum annum) against Diverse Metabolic Complications
pmc-10534530.creator: Phiwayinkosi V. Dludla, Ilenia Cirilli, Fabio Marcheggiani, Sonia Silvestri, Patrick Orlando, Ndivhuwo Muvhulawa, Marakiya T. Moetlediwa, Bongani B. Nkambule, Sithandiwe E. Mazibuko-Mbeje, Nokulunga Hlengwa, Sidney Hanser, Duduzile Ndwandwe, Jeanine L. Marnewick, Albertus K. Basson, Luca Tiano
pmc-10534530.description: The consumption of food-derived products, including the regular intake of pepper, is increasingly evaluated for its potential benefits in protecting against diverse metabolic complications. The current study made use of prominent electronic databases including PubMed, Google Scholar, and Scopus to retrieve clinical evidence linking the intake of black and red pepper with the amelioration of metabolic complications.

pmc-10675042.title: Antidepressant-like Effect of Oroxylum indicum Seed Extract in Mice Model of Unpredictable Chronic Mild Stress
pmc-10675042.creator: Chorpeth Chalermwongkul, Charinya Khamphukdee, Juthamart Maneenet, Supawadee Daodee, Orawan Monthakantirat, Chantana Boonyarat, Yutthana Chotritthirong, Suresh Awale, Anake Kijjoa, Yaowared Chulikhit, Hiroshi Kunugi
pmc-10675042.description: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is one life-threatening disorder that is prevalent worldwide. The evident etiology of this disease is still poorly understood. Currently, herbal medicine is gaining more interest as an alternative antidepressant. Oroxylum indicum, which is used in traditional medicine and contains a potential antidepressive compound, baicalein, could have an antidepressive property.

pmc-11401154.title: Beyond the Buzz: Cortical and subcortical brain changes in patients with pulsatile tinnitus
pmc-11401154.creator: Justin Remer, Kazim Narsinh, Travis Caton, Alison Lamboy, Adelyn Tu-Chan, Ashish Raj, Matthew R. Amans
pmc-11401154.description: Highlights•This is the first study to demonstrate significant differences in brain anatomy in a large cohort of patients with pulsatile tinnitus providing insight into the neurological sequale of this disease.•Patients with pulsatile tinnitus exhibited significant decreases in cortical thickness in the anterior cingulate and entorhinal cortex, and decreased volume in the left putamen, compared to age-matched controls.

pmc-11443927.title: A deep learning approach for deriving wheat phenology from near-surface RGB image series using spatiotemporal fusion
pmc-11443927.creator: Yucheng Cai, Yan Li, Xuerui Qi, Jianqing Zhao, Li Jiang, Yongchao Tian, Yan Zhu, Weixing Cao, Xiaohu Zhang
pmc-11443927.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Accurate monitoring of wheat phenological stages is essential for effective crop management and informed agricultural decision-making. Traditional methods often rely on labour-intensive field surveys, which are prone to subjective bias and limited temporal resolution. To address these challenges, this study explores the potential of near-surface cameras combined with an advanced deep-learning approach to derive wheat phenological stages from high-quality, real-time RGB image series.

pmc-11502417.title: Exploring Socioeconomic Disparities in Surgical Site Infections
pmc-11502417.creator: Michael Dewitt, Caroline Reinke, Michael Inman, Werner Bischoff, Shelley Kester, Mindy Sampson, Anupama Neelakanta, Katie Passaretti
pmc-11502417.description: Introduction: Social disparities have been shown to impact a wide variety of healthcare outcomes. Surgical site infections (SSIs) are associated with substantial patient morbidity, but studies on the intersection of social disparity and SSI are limited. We sought to evaluate the association between SSI and the Center for Disease Control and Prevention’s social vulnerability index (SVI).

pmc-11561043.creator: Matthew Crown, Matthew Bashton
pmc-11561043.description: MotivationMappings of domain-cognate ligand interactions can enhance our understanding of the core concepts of evolution and be used to aid docking and protein design. Since the last available cognate-ligand domain database was released, the PDB has grown significantly and new tools are available for measuring similarity and determining contacts.

pmc-11738159.title: Ethical Challenges in the Use of Digital Tools for Screening of Depression in India: A Scoping Review
pmc-11738159.creator: Francesca Townsend, Ahmed Waqas, Atif Rahman
pmc-11738159.description: AimsDepression poses a significant public health concern globally, characterized by prolonged periods of sadness, loss of interest, and impairment in daily functioning. With over 800,000 annual deaths attributed to suicide, it stands as the second leading cause of mortality among 15–29-year-olds worldwide.

pmc-12413820.title: Comparison of the Diagnostic Performance of Culture, Histopathology, and mNGS for Periprosthetic Joint Infection Using Periprosthetic Tissue Samples: A Prospective Clinical Study
pmc-12413820.creator: Lan Wei, Yali Yu, Shaohua Wang, Guixiang Dong, Yanli Niu
pmc-12413820.description: BackgroundThis study evaluated the applicability of histopathology, culture, and Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) in diagnosing periprosthetic joint infection (PJI).MethodsIn this prospective trial, 215 consecutive patients with suspected knee PJI were enrolled. Tissue specimens were aseptically collected and processed for histopathological analysis, culture, and mNGS.

pmc-12536163.title: Analysis of P Values in the Abstract Compared With the Main Text of Randomized Controlled Trials and Clinical Trials of Mesenchymal Stromal Cells for the Treatment of Knee Osteoarthritis
pmc-12536163.creator: Nesa Milan, Katherine Woolley, Zubin Master, Brian T. Feeley
pmc-12536163.description: Background:Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and clinical trials (CTs) are critical for evaluating treatment effectiveness, with abstracts serving as the primary source of the study that is read.Purpose:This study explored selective reporting of significant P values in the abstracts of RCTs and CTs on mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) for the treatment of knee osteoarthritis (OA).

pmc-12817662.title: The epidemiological characteristics of notifiable infectious diseases in a Yunnan hospital, China, 2014–2023
pmc-12817662.creator: Yuanyuan Zhang, Yiwen Zhang, Fang Zhou, Shangmei Chen, Dingmei Dai, Chungang Li, Yan Duan, Min Liu
pmc-12817662.description: BackgroundYunnan, particularly its border area, has consistently been identified with a high incidence of infectious diseases in China. pmc-12843072.description: The detection of zeranol in grazing cattle could be explained by the metabolization of the mycotoxin, zearalenone (ZEA), which was proven to be naturally contaminating the grasses harboring the Fusarium species.
